title: Protein extraction, quantification, and western blot for Bodo saltans
author: Ewa Chrostek
materials: Quantify protein (eg. using the Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay Kit, (Thermo Fisher) according to the kit instructions).
1. Separate protein extracts on polyacrylamide gels (eg. Bolt Bis-Tris Plus, Thermo Fisher).
2. Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane (eg. using mini blot module (Thermo Fisher)).

steps.title: Culture Bodo saltans
steps.instruction: Culture Bodo saltans in a cerophyl-based medium enriched with 3.5 mM sodium phosphate dibasic (Na2HPO4) at 22 °C in T25 tissue culture flasks containing 20 ml of media bacterized with Klebsiella pneumoniae subsp. Pneumoniae (ATCC® 700831).

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 20 ml of 1 week old culture at 1200 × g for 12 mins at 19 °C to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare lysis buffer consisting of 150 mM NaCl, 1% Triton X-100, 50 mM TrisHCl (pH8), and 5 mM EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Supplement with cOmplete Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Roche) at 1 tablet per 10 ml of solution immediately before extraction.
Supplement with Benzonase nuclease (Sigma) immediately before extraction.

steps.title: Extract proteins
steps.instruction: Dissolve the cell pellet in the prepared lysis buffer and incubate the extract on ice for 30 mins.

steps.title: Clear lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the extract at 8000 × g to pellet debris and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare samples for western blot
steps.instruction: Adjust protein concentrations so that they are equal between samples.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane for 30 mins at room temperature in 5% skimmed milk diluted in wash buffer (PBS with 0.1% Tween20).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane overnight at 4 °C with primary antibodies (1:100 dilution in 5% milk in wash buffer).

steps.title: Wash membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 × 10 mins with wash buffer (PBS with 0.1% Tween 20).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane for 1 hour at room temperature with Horseradish Peroxidase (HRP)-labelled secondary antibodies (1:5000 dilution in 5% milk in wash buffer).

steps.title: Final wash
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 × 10 mins with wash buffer (PBS with 0.1% Tween 20).

steps.title: Develop and scan signal
steps.instruction: Develop the signal with HRP substrate (e.g., Immobilon western kit, Merk) and scan for chemiluminescent signal (e.g., with ImageQuant LAS4000 or Bio Rad imaging system).
